text:
Jon (AE): FYI - Prospect (Evernorth Systems) returned the MSA/DPA with a few unusual asks: explicit KMS escrow language, PAdES-certified signatures instead of DocuSign, and Net60 on PO. They also want SLA uptime tied to a creditback formula. Need quick alignment so we don't lose the POC slot.

Priya (Legal): Can you paste the exact redlines? KMS escrow is rare; do they want key escrow or just escrow notification? PAdES is fine but we need to confirm our signing provider supports certified timestamps. SLA creditback: we should limit total liability and have a cap tied to the POC amount.

Jon (AE): Redline snippets: "Vendor must escrow keys with a mutually approved third-party escrow and provide certificate of escrow prior to production." "All signatures must be PAdES-LTV with qualified timestamping or equivalent." "SLA credit equals 5% of monthly invoice per 30m downtime (capped at 100%)." Also they asked for three-way PO matching and a custom remit instruction block.

Priya (Legal): Proposed counters: (1) Escrow language -> accept notification and ability to provide escrow certificate from our KMS vendor within 10 business days; we cannot escrow live private keys. If they insist on escrow of key material, that requires a separate escrow SOW. (2) PAdES -> we can provide PAdES-LTV compliant PDFs if our signing stack can produce qualified timestamps; need security ops to confirm. (3) SLA credit -> negotiate cap to the greater of monthly invoice or 3x POC fee, not 100% open-ended.

Marcus (Finance): Net60 is higher risk. For POCs under $30k we permit Net30; Net60 requires CFO approval and a credit check. Three-way matching increases AP friction (PO, invoice, goods receipt). Ask procurement if they can accept milestone billing (50% upfront) instead of Net60. Also need to capture the exact PO number and vendor tax info on invoice.

Olga (Security): PAdES/LTV: we can sign PDFs with RFC 3161 timestamping and embed OCSP/CRL for long-term validation. Need to confirm our timestamping authority (TSA) meets their "qualified timestamp" expectation; that can be a negotiation point. For escrow: we can provide a vendor-issued escrow certificate showing the escrow agreement with a third-party (e.g., KeySafe) but cannot deposit live keys. If they demand escrow of key material, that's a security red flag.

infra-bot: Uploaded attachments: https://secure.docs/redwood/evernorth/evernorth_msa_dpa_v4.pdf ; created checklist: [Escrow language decision] [PAdES timestamping confirmation] [Finance Net terms decision] [SLA cap negotiation]

Jon (AE): I'll push back on full key escrow and propose the escrow-certificate + 10 business day attestation. I'll also ask procurement if PAdES acceptance is strict or if a portal-hash + timestamped upload is OK. PO estimate for POC is $26k.

Priya (Legal): I'll draft two short alternatives: (A) Acceptable: "Vendor will provide an escrow certificate from its KMS vendor and deliver a signed attestation within 10 business days upon request; production keys will not be escrowed without a separate SOW." (B) If they insist: add SOW path describing secure escrow mechanism, liability, and key handoff procedures. Also I'll propose SLA language: credit capped at the lesser of monthly invoice or 3x monthly POC fee, and exclude scheduled maintenance.

Marcus (Finance): With PO at ~$26k Net30 is our default. If they insist on Net60, route to me with procurement justification and I'll run quick credit (24-48h) and escalate to CFO if needed. Milestone billing could be a good alternative.

Olga (Security): I'll validate our TSA meets their "qualified timestamp" requirement and report back. If not, we can offer portal time-stamped uploads + hash chain as a practical equivalent.

Jon (AE): Actions: 1) I'll ask procurement whether Net60 is mandatory or negotiable and whether they can accept escrow-certificate + attestation instead of live key escrow. 2) Priya will post two addendum options. 3) Marcus will prep finance decision if Net60 insisted. 4) Olga to confirm timestamping capability.

Priya (Legal): Drafting addendum options now; will drop link when ready.

Jon (AE): Thanks all — need to lock this today if possible, procurement is asking for a signed order by end of week. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
